_help: For each name: set links[name] to an existing PersonID if it is the same human, or move the name into creates if it is a different person. Empty string means undecided.
_decisions_note: The writer's automatic collision check runs only for candidates with no person_record.id, which was Galen Fowler and Christopher K. Pankratz. The seven initials-only names below carried a person_record.id in the enriched input that resolves to no file in the clone, so they bypassed the check and were created at the asserted ID. Every surname below was searched by hand against Person/ at master; findings recorded per name. No genuine duplicate was found, so all nine were created.
